fields.sentence: Sky-cats roost on the cliff-spires during the day.

q2_gaps: "during the day" — a temporal frame headed by 'during' whose object is a calendar period rather than an eventuality: the instruction set reserves During strictly for 'during / while / throughout' nesting two reified eventualities, and its day-part inventory (morning / afternoon / evening / night, dawn / noon / dusk) does not include daytime 'day', so no rule states how to encode this adjunct.
review.notes: Bare-plural generic to a distributing rule at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase is right, as are the definite plural 'the cliff-spires' as a group witness and Location for an event-side 'on'. Roost sits close to the postural-stative list (perch / rest), which would make the subject an Experiencer, but the instruction's explicit 'when unclear, Agent' default covers the choice made.

fields.sentence: Sky-cats do not enter the village.

review.notes: Matches the negated-verbal-generic pattern exactly — the distributing rule at (STV 0.0 0.9) over the kind-naming bare plural, the definite "the village" typed at top level outside the denial, no QuantifierPhrase for plain "not", and Theme for an unchanged direct object.

"The Keepers" follows the capitalized-plural label rule exactly (Name-only individual, no GroupOf, no invented type atom), and the bare-plural kind object correctly stays the bare kind filler with only the sky_cat genus emitted (noun modifier not exposed). Treating "tolerate" as an ordinary transitive (Agent/Theme) rather than a stative psych verb is supported by the progressive test the instruction set prescribes.
